correctness.rationale: Even summand of dimension 32 is central and odd commutator is twice wedge product. A nonzero degree-one part yields wedge kernel dimension 16 by homogeneous equations. Otherwise nonzero trivectors yield odd kernel 25+k(alpha), where k(alpha) in {0,1,3}; incidence of annihilating lines and decomposable 3-spaces yields D0,D1,D3. Pure fifth degree yields 31, zero gives 32. Direct independent SymPy simplification verifies row total q^64 and exactly the stated commuting-probability rational function, evaluated exactly at q=3,5,7.
